title: Choose the visual world for Ibukun's portfolio
question: The roll assigned The Postal Sheet. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Postal Sheet
options.lineage: airmail stamp sheets, franked and postmarked
options.thesis: Every project is a stamp on one sheet, and the whole page is mail that arrived.
options.viewport: A perforated sheet of project stamps with a DELIVERED postmark, the headline and a red stamp-shaped Email me beside it.
options.risk: Reads as novelty if the perforation and postmark are overdone.

raised.raise: Every stamp locks to one strict perforation grid, so the sheet scans like a table.
The Email me stamp physically overlaps the sheet edge, so the action enters the composition.

options.label: The Bill of Lading
options.lineage: freight manifests and shipping container yards
options.thesis: You are the shipper; each project is a numbered container with its paperwork.
options.viewport: Giant stencilled headline over a row of four container blocks with a manifest form beside it.
options.risk: The shipping pun is the most literal reading of ships end to end.

options.label: Phosphor Terminal
options.thesis: The portfolio as a live transcript on glass.
options.viewport: A command transcript that lists the work as directory entries.
options.case: Engineers recognise it instantly, but its one monospaced field is slower to scan than the Postal Sheet.
options.risk: The developer-portfolio cliché, and long text is tiring in green mono.

options.label: Agit-Train
options.thesis: Projects as railcars driven along one red diagonal.
options.viewport: A red wedge carries the headline over three railcars, with a clipped Email me wedge.
options.case: Boldest and clearest call to action, but the political register is a stretch for a hiring site.
options.risk: Angled type can hurt readability for recruiters skimming.

options.label: Memory Quilt
options.case: Fuses poorly: recruiters do not identify with domestic memory objects.
options.kept: Every block carries its own date and provenance.

options.label: Accretion Disk
options.case: Fuses poorly: an astrophysics spectacle hides the experience a recruiter came to read.
options.kept: Total commitment to one dark ground.

options.label: Minihompy Room
options.case: Fuses poorly: a decorated room signals play, not hiring-grade reliability.
options.kept: Small honest counters as real chrome.

options.label: Plane Portrait
options.case: Fuses poorly: it needs a portrait and a figure, and the site has neither.
options.kept: Total commitment to a small set of flat colours.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean developer portfolio executed with full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Name and one line at left, a grid of three project cards below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other developer portfolios by design.
